CURRENT QUESTION:
share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
attempts.response:
WITH donor_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    "Donor",
    COUNT(*) AS donation_count
  FROM "donations"
  GROUP BY "Donor"
),
repeat_givers AS (
  SELECT "Donor"
  FROM donor_counts
  WHERE donation_count > 1
),
one_time_givers AS (
  SELECT "Donor"
  FROM donor_counts
  WHERE donation_count = 1
),
repeat_amounts AS (
  SELECT SUM(d."Amount") AS total_amount
  FROM "donations" d
  JOIN repeat_givers r ON d."Donor" = r."Donor"
),
one_time_amounts AS (
  SELECT SUM(d."Amount") AS total_amount
  FROM "donations" d
  JOIN one_time_givers o ON d."Donor" = o."Donor"
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(r.total_amount, 0) AS repeat_total,
    COALESCE(o.total_amount, 0) AS one_time_total
  FROM repeat_amounts r
  CROSS JOIN one_time_amounts o
),
final AS (
  SELECT 
    repeat_total,
    one_time_total,
    repeat_total + one_time_total AS grand_total
  FROM totals
)
SELECT 
  (100.0 * repeat_total / NULLIF(grand_total, 0)) AS share_of_money_from_repeat_givers_percent,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repeat_givers) AS count_of_repeat_givers
FROM final;
